description:
"Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes, dealing |cffffff7360|r Frost Damage. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

Consume all Crux and increase Tentacular Dread damage by |cffffff33|r% and damage to foes drenched in Abyssal Ink by |cffffff2|r% per Crux spent."
